changelog: Adds eight Survival settings through the shared typed runtime API, original attribute bounds, player-template configuration and the engine durability setting.

noFallDamage.label: No Fall Damage
noFallDamage.description: Disables fall damage through the original fall configuration. Players using the same player template share this effect.

fastHealthRegen.label: Fast Health Regen
fastHealthRegen.description: Increases the existing health recharge value in the original attribute by up to 100 times. This setting has no effect without natural regeneration.

fastManaRegen.label: Fast Mana Regen
fastManaRegen.description: Increases the existing mana recharge value in the original attribute by up to 100 times. This setting has no effect without natural regeneration.

infiniteStamina.label: Infinite Stamina
infiniteStamina.description: Keeps stamina at its current maximum through the original attribute lower bound. Changes to the maximum are applied automatically.

infiniteUnderwaterBreath.label: Infinite Underwater Breath
infiniteUnderwaterBreath.description: Keeps the underwater breath reserve at its current maximum through the original attribute lower bound.

infiniteWeaponDurability.label: Infinite Weapon Durability
infiniteWeaponDurability.description: Disables durability loss for the entire hosted world, including items equipped by other players. Restores the previous world setting when disabled.

infiniteFrostTimer.label: Infinite Frost Timer
infiniteFrostTimer.description: Keeps body warmth at its current maximum through the original attribute lower bound.

infiniteMana.label: Infinite Mana
infiniteMana.description: Keeps mana at its current maximum through the original attribute lower bound. Changes to the maximum are applied automatically.

groups.label: Survival
groups.description: Enables individual survival features. Changes to settings are saved immediately.
